name: Ogryn
note: Maximums from the table on p.91 (Intellect maximum 1 as printed). No Species Keywords printed; ABHUMAN by GM ruling (docs/rules-flow.md §11.27). Abhuman rules from pp.90–91; "Ogyrns" in Psychic Species is a print error, copied as printed.

abilities.name: Avalanche of Muscle
abilities.text: When you Charge you gain an additional +Rank Bonus Dice to your melee attack Test.

abilities.name: Claustrophobic
abilities.text: Whenever you enter an enclosed area you must make a Fear Test (default DN 2). Additionally, whenever you roll a Complication in an enclosed space, the GM can spend 1 Ruin to force you to repeat this Fear Test.

abilities.name: Simple Loyalty
abilities.text: Whenever an ally with the IMPERIUM Keyword makes a Leadership Test targeting an Ogryn they gain Bonus Dice equal to the Ogryn’s Rank.

abilities.name: Species & Communication
abilities.text: By default, abhumans suffer a +1 DN penalty to any social Test with a Human target, modified by the target’s Keywords.

abilities.name: Psychic Species
abilities.text: There are no recorded instances of either Ratlings or Ogryns with psychic abilities. Ratlings and Ogyrns cannot have the PSYKER Keyword.

abilities.name: Armour for Abhumans
abilities.text: For abhumans such as Ratlings and Ogryns, the Rarity of any Armour is increased by +1.

abilities.name: Weapons for Ogryns
abilities.text:
The prodigious size of an Ogryn’s hands and digits means they are unable to wield most ranged weapons as they cannot pull the trigger. This does not preclude them from using any ranged weapon as a club, which deals the same damage as an Unarmed Strike (page 183 of the Wrath & Glory Rulebook) +2 ED.

An Ogryn can wield any melee weapon they can conceivably hold, though they treat any weapon designed for someone of a smaller size as having the Unwieldy (3) Weapon Trait.

mods.what: Ogryn: a melee weapon designed for someone smaller counts as Unwieldy (3)
Ogryn: most ranged weapons can't be fired (no trigger finger); as a club it deals Unarmed Strike damage +2 ED

name: Kroot
note: Maximums from the table on p.91. No Species Keywords printed; KROOT by GM ruling (docs/rules-flow.md §11.27). The species table's first columns are shifted as printed ("Kroot" under XP Cost, "22" under Attributes): XP 22, no Attributes. Kroot Mutations are the option group kroot-mutations (p.98). As a PSYKER it learns powers from a single Discipline of choice (Disciplines Known, Core p.257): the PSYKER-only grant.

abilities.name: Kroot Mutations
abilities.text: You have a number of Kroot Mutations equal to your Tier, and may gain additional Kroot Mutations as part of Ascension.

abilities.name: Kroot Language
abilities.text:
The multi-faceted biology of the Kroot has led to them developing many different methods of communication. Xenobiologists speculate that the pervasive, shifting scent of the viscous sweat that covers a Kroot’s body can be controlled, allowing them to clandestinely communicate through scent. When the Kroot communicate audibly, they do so with a rattling of their quills and a system of whistles and clicks through their beaked mouths.

The few who have had non-combative contact with the Species have noted that they tend to mimic other Species, capable of discerning meaning through tone, posture, and possibly even pheromones. As a possible side effect of their own mutable nature, Kroot pick up new languages quickly and easily.

Whenever a Kroot makes a Test to understand a spoken language, they gain +Rank Bonus Dice.

abilities.name: Species & Communication
abilities.text: As a Xenos Species, the Kroot are feared and hated by almost all Imperials. Because of this, they suffer the usual minimum penalty of +2 DN to any social Test with a target of another Species.

abilities.name: Armour for Kroot
abilities.text:
Kroot biology is anathema to most forms of armour. Their strange proportions and digitigrade legs make sizing difficult, and their reliance on fieldcraft forces them to eschew the bulky protective plates employed by other Species. Though Kroot Shapers would prefer to evolve a tougher, scalier hide through consuming resilient foes than design some new form of protection, many Kroot Mercenaries wear makeshift armour plating that affords some small defence from arms fire without prohibiting movement.

Kroot cannot wear armour that they do not share a Keyword with. Additionally, if a Kroot wears armour with an AR of 4 or more, the DN of all Tests using the Strength, Agility, or Initiative Attribute increase by an amount equal to the AR of the armour.

abilities.name: Weapons for Kroot
abilities.text:
For melee combat, the Kroot prefer their own brand of primitive firearms festooned with blades, but can adapt to almost any kind of weaponry given enough time.

Kroot can wield any weapon, but if the weapon does not have the PRIMITIVE Keyword or share a Keyword with the Kroot, the weapon is treated as having the Unwieldy (2) Weapon Trait.

mods.what: Kroot: Unwieldy (2) unless the weapon has the PRIMITIVE Keyword or shares a Keyword with the Kroot (KROOT)
